description: GATE-SPEED F5: the git settings every script test process gets through the environment (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n>, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n>) as well as through gate.test_git_config: a fixture that points GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL at /dev/null (seven did) dropped the hermetic file, and every commit and push it made ran git's automatic maintenance again. No identity here: a test may set its own.
